content: Ovaariperoshiretziriri atziri
Ipoña ipokaiyakeni Fariseo itsipatakari iyotzinkariite. Ipoñaayetaka nampitsiki Jerusalén. Ikantapaakeri Jesús:
“Judío anaiyini. Iro ametaiyari akivaakota tekera ovanakyaata, ari okanta jiyotaayetairi pairani acharineete. ¿Opaitama kaari jimatantaro piyotaane? Jovapiintaiyani te inkivero irako.”
Jakanake Jesús, ikantzi: “Irojatzi paakoventa eerokaite jiyotaayetairi pairani acharineete, temaita pimatantaro jiyotaayetairi Pava.
Jiroka ikantziri Pava:
Ikantake eejatzi:
Iro kantamaitacha pikantashitapiinta eeroka: ‘Aritatsi ankanteri ashiyetairi: “Nokashiyakaakeri Pava maaroni noireekite, eero okantzi nonkaminthaimi eeroka.” ’
Piyotaantashiyetakaro jameyeetari pairani, te piyotaantero ikovakaajaantairi Pava. Irootakera kaari jetakotantaari asheninka ashitariri.
Kamataviri pinaiyini. Eeroka iñaaventake pairani Isaías, ikantake:
Ikaimakeri Jesús maaroni piyotzimentakariri, ikantziri: “Pinkempisantaiyeni, pinkemathatantyaarori noñaaventeri:
Ikaratzi ovayetari te jovaariperoshiretantzi, irooma okaratzi añaavaiyetziri, iroora matzirori ovaariperoshiretantzi.”
Ipoña ipokashitapaakeri iriyotaane okarikiini, ikantapaakeri: “Te onimoteri Fariseo-payeeni ikemakemi pikantake.”
Ikantanake Jesús: “Ashitanari Inkitesatzi, ari inthonkairo okaratzi kaari ipankitzi irirori.
Piñaashityaari, te iriyotaiyeni irirori, joshiyakari aparoni mavityaakiri. Ikempitakotakari eejatzi jakathatavakaa mavityaakiri, te iriyote tsika inkene, apiteroite imparyee omoronaki.”
Ari ikantzi Pedro: “Pooñaarontenaro okaratzi poshiyakaaventakeneriri irikapayeeni.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “¿Tekerama ontzimimotemi eeroka piyotane?
¿Tema piyote okaratzi ovayetapiintari okenayetzi asheetoki, impoña amishitovairo?
Irooma añaavaitero kaariperori akinkishireyetari, irootake ovaariperoshiretantatsiri.
Tema ashireki opoñaayeta kaariperori kinkishiretaantsi, ovantaantsi, mayempitaantsi, kaari kinataantsi, koshitaantsi, thaiyakotaantsi, kishimataantsi.
Irootakera iroka ovaariperoshiretantatsiri. Irooma eerorika akivaakota ankoverika oya, te ovaariperoshiretantzi iroori.”
Okempisantzi tsinane Canaán-sato
Ipoña ikenanake Jesús nampitsiki paitachari Tiro irojatzi Sidón-ki.

Ari opokashitakeri janta aparoni tsinane Canaán-sato, te judío onatye iroori. Okantapaakeri: “Novinkatharite, eeroka icharine pinkathari David-ni. Nokovi pinkaminthagaina osheki oñaashitakaro nishinto, jaakiro peyari.”
Ari jimairetake Jesús, te irakero. Ipoña ikantaiyini iriyotaane: “Pomityaantairo iyaataita, osheki oñaashirenkakai.”
Ikantanakero Jesús: “Intaani jotyaantakena Ashitanari nonkaminthaayetairi nosheninka Israel-mirinkaite, ikaratzi oshiyakariri oisha ipeyayetaka.”
Iro kantamaitacha tsinaneka, otyeerovashitanakari Jesús, okantanakeri: “Pinkatharí, pinkaminthagaina naaka.”
Ikantanakero irirori: “Apaata tsinane. Tema ikantaitakeranki: ‘Te aapithateri irovarite eentsite amperi otsitzi iroyaaro.’”
Akanakeri iroori, okantziri: “Omapero pikantakeri Pinkatharí. Iro kantamaitacha, jovapiintamatsitaro otsitzi jovaryaayeetziro ovaritentsi otapinaki.”
Jakanairo Jesús, ikantziro: “Tsinané, omapero pikempisantai eeroka. Irootake nomatantyaarori pikovakotakenari.” Apathakero avisakotai ishinto.
Jovashinchaake Jesús osheki atziri
Ipoña jovaanaka Jesús ikenayetake othapyaaki inkaare Galilea. Irojatzi itonkaantanakari otzishiki, ari isaikapaakeri janta.
Ari ipokashitakeriri osheki atziri, jamayetakeri kantavaiyetachari imantsiyare: ethorivaitatsiri, mavityaakiri, kisovaanteri, pesaponthokiri, maaroni. Ithonkiri jovashinchaayetairi.

Ipampoyaaminthaitakeri Jesús jiñeetakerira iñaavaitakagairi kisovaanteri, janiitakaayetairi kisoporokiri, ethorivaitatsiri eejatzi, jamenakaayetairi mavityaakiri. Ikantaiyini atziriite: “Omapero ikameethatataike Pava, iriitake pinkathariventairiri Israel-mirinkaite.”
Jovakaari Jesús 4,000 atziri

Ipoña Jesús japatotakeri iriyotaane, ikantakeri: “Osheki netakotakari atziriite, tema mava kitaite isaikaiyakeni jaka ikempisantana, tekatsi irovaiya. Aririka iriyaatashitaiya eero jovanaa, ari aakeri itashe avotsiki.”
Ikantaiyini iriyotaane: “Pamene, asaikatziira jaka tsika te inampiitaro. ¿Tsikama ayeka ovakaiyaariri? Osheki ikarataiyini.”
Ari josampitziri Jesús iriyotaane: “¿Tsikama okaratzi tanta tzimatsiri?” Ikantzi iriyotaane: “Tzimatsi okaratzi 7, tzimitacha eejatzi shimaaniki.”
Ipoña ikantaitakeri ikaratzi piyotainchari: “Pisaikaiyeni.”
Jaakero tanta ipoña shimaaniki, ipaasoonkeventakero. Ipoña ipetoryaakero tanta, ipayetakeri iriyotaane, jovavisaakeneri piyotainchari atziri.
Ovaiyakani maaroni, kemaiyakani. Ipoña japatotairo tzimakaantapaintsiri, ijaikitai okaratzi 7 kantziri.
Kempitaka ikaratzi 4,000 shirampari ovainchari. Tzimitacha eejatzi tsinanepayeeni ipoña eentsipayeeni ovainchari.
Ipoña ikantanai Jesús: “Ari avaiyakani, kantatsi piyaayetai.” Ari jotetanaa Jesús pitotsiki, montyaanaka iipatsiteki Magdala-satzi.
